items.title: GitHub - vercel-labs/agent-desktop: Agent Desktop gives any agent reliable computer use on the desktop. Built with Rust, it sees any app's real UI structure through OS accessibility trees and operates it — refs stay stable and actions stay safe to retry,
items.summary: Computer use for AI agents: read and operate desktop apps through the OS accessibility tree. A CLI and C library for macOS, Windows and Linux.
